problem: What is the trace in the $xz$-plane of the sphere ${x}^{2}+{y}^{2}+(z-1)^{2}=2?$

feedback.problem: What is the trace in the $xz$-plane of the ellipsoid $\frac{{x}^{2}}{8}+\frac{{y}^{2}}{5}+\frac{(z-3)^{2}}{2}=1?$
feedback.worked_solution:
To find the trace in the $xz$-plane, we substitute $y=0$ into the equation of the ellipsoid:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{{x}^{2}}{8}+\frac{{0}^{2}}{5}+\frac{(z-3)^{2}}{2} & =1 \\ \frac{{x}^{2}}{8}+\frac{(z-3)^{2}}{2} & =1 \\ \frac{{x}^{2}}{(2\sqrt{2})^{2}}+\frac{(z-3)^{2}}{(\sqrt{2})^{2}} & =1\end{aligned}
$$

This gives us the equation of the ellipse with semi-axes $2\sqrt{2}$ and $\sqrt{2},$ centered at $(0,3)$ in the $xz$-plane.

submitted_fields.submitted_value: An ellipse with semi-axes $2\sqrt{2}$ and $\sqrt{2},$ centered at $(0,3)$ in the $xz$-plane
